column1: # Words never offered as COMPLETIONS (docs/04 §5). They stay valid exact matches (typing the whole word
# still finds them). One base-form word per line.
#   drop:word       never a completion AND the pipeline drops corpus lines containing it (explicit web text
#                   must not skew the language model toward that register)
#   prefix:stem     like drop:, for every token starting with stem
# Only unambiguous explicit terms get drop:/prefix:. Words with ordinary meanings (e.g. شاذ "irregular",
# مص "suck", عاهرة in news) are listed plainly or not at all. OWNER: review and extend.
